stem: One cultivar responds positively to a training intensity while another shows slower recovery under otherwise similar conditions. What is the strongest conclusion?
choices: Cultivar response should remain explicit and the practice should not be treated as universally optimal
The slower cultivar must have been trained incorrectly
The positive response proves the same intensity should be standardized for all cultivars
Cultivar identity can be removed from future records
rationale: Published and practical responses can differ by cultivar, so training outcomes should preserve genotype/cultivar context.
